title: Transition Formula Evaluation
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$, and assign a Boolean value to every encoded bit. The transition CNF evaluates to true exactly when, for every choice of a position, a transition case, and an encoded bit, the corresponding gate evaluates to true on the assignment induced by its gate wires.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes
A Boolean assignment to every encoded bit
